scripts.render:tiktok: node scripts/prepare.mjs && remotion render Tiktok15 out/tiktok15.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --concurrency=1
scripts.render:trailer: node scripts/prepare.mjs && remotion render Trailer30 out/trailer30.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --concurrency=1
scripts.render:bumper: node scripts/prepare.mjs && remotion render Bumper6 out/bumper6.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --concurrency=1
scripts.render:all: npm run render:tiktok && npm run render:trailer && npm run render:bumper
scripts.still:tiktok: node scripts/prepare.mjs && remotion still Tiktok15 out/tiktok15-frame.png --frame=20
